plan.title: SRC-E2E-002 Material PR to Split Award PO

steps.note: Check that the selected PR line exposes its API-backed quantity.
Check that the selected PR line exposes its API-backed unit.
Give the event the required title so it can be published and found later.
Commit the requested 30-minute event schedule; the explicit evaluation duration is not configurable through this step.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors for the two required vendor bids without inventing supplier names.
Publish the PR-created RFQ after its template, items, schedule, participants, and T&C are configured.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's portal bid at 100; numeric vendor selection avoids inventing a company name.
Verify that the first vendor's portal bid was submitted.
Submit Vendor B's portal bid at 90 from the second vendor portal session.
Verify that the second vendor's portal bid was submitted.
Wait for the bidding window to close so responses and awarding are available.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding has ended.
Assert that the lower bid ranks first, proving Vendor B's 90 bid is ahead of Vendor A's 100 bid.
Enter the awarding screen to allocate the line quantities.

args.goal: allocate 6 units to Vendor B and 4 units to Vendor A on the awarding screen, then stop when the screen shows both vendor allocations

steps.note: The catalog has no quantity-specific split-allocation assertion, so perform and observe the exact 6/4 allocation directly on the buyer screen.
Create the award proposal after the split allocation is shown.
Submit the created proposal for approval.

args.remark: Approved for the split award to both vendors.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved split award.
Verify that the created purchase orders contain two awarded PO lines in total.
Return to the events list to verify the event's post-close history placement.
Open the History tab where the closed event should appear.
Assert that this plan's event is present in event history.
